name: It's a Secret to Everybody
label: Quest
description: It's a Secret to Everybody: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: A destroyed raft rests along the shoreline. Considering this is only a small pond, it is not clear as to how it ended up here, although looking at the trees tells you that the water level may not be constant.
Perhaps a little exploration in the area might uncover more clues...

clips.title: Completion
paras: A water-logged pack rests at the bottom of the pond.
